shots.alt: The view cube in the corner of the view, its faces named, with buttons round it to slide, zoom and fit.
shots.caption: The view cube: click a face, edge or corner to look from there.

shots.alt: The red car cut away by a plane, showing the inside of its parts, with the cut-away's strip of choices along the view.
shots.caption: View › Cut away (K) shows the inside; its strip changes the shape and side.

shots.alt: The model area split in two: the red car turned three-quarters on the left, and straight from the front on the right with Front, Top, Side, Back and Fit above it.
shots.caption: View › Split (F8) shows the model from two sides at once.
